basic_info.description: This 4-bed, 3-bath home has been lovingly cared for by the same family for over two decades. South-facing living and dining area with 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths on the main level, plus family room, 1 more bedroom and 1 full bath on the ground level, ideal for guests or a home office. Updated kitchen with Thermador and Viking stainless steel appliances and recessed lighting. Resurfaced original oak flooring, freshly repainted interior and exterior, including updated LED light fixtures. Well maintained, mature manicured backyard. The garage offers storage galore with multiple shelving options, cabinets and built-ins. Conveniently located near Ocean Beach, SF Zoo, Lakeshore Plaza, Harding Golf Course, and Stonestown Mall.
